source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hi, the home page looks excellent. On the services page, could we include an image corresponding to each service offered? I would like to visually feature the photo, twilights, floor plan, 3d, etc. Because we are primarily a photography business, I want every page to be highly visual and image-focused. Could we remove the monthly and annual tabs from the services page? Our pricing is one-time only. Could we also provide four bundle spaces rather than 3? In addition, could we add a large diagram showing all the individual services we offer? I prefer complete pricing transparency so customers can select individual items when necessary and understand exactly how the pricing is divided. I am attaching a PDF containing every item [PERSON_NAME_004] needs to be included. Most items are also grouped according to price and the house's square footage. I like the gallery design. The only necessary tabs are photos, twilights, videos, floor plans, and 3d tour. There could perhaps be a smaller area for other photography, since we occasionally take one-off clients. During development of the actual website, could the gallery items have hover animations? The pages are looking excellent!
